focal_run.experiment_design_note: NCBI Run Browser states that unenriched libraries were mixed with target-enriched libraries at a 3:2 ratio before sequencing.
focal_run.read_structure: 2 x 125 bp biological reads; 2,625,581 spots; 656,395,250 total bases

target_reference_versions.claim_boundary: Public 1061-locus reference; not the exact author 1064-target universe.

target_reference_versions.reconstruction_rule: Recover homologous exons from the high-coverage source with the public original Compositae1061 target and append them by locus, reproducing the published logic without claiming byte identity to the authors' intermediate file.
target_reference_versions.claim_boundary: Adds tioganum homologs to the public 1061 locus IDs. It does not establish or reproduce the unresolved three-locus difference behind the paper-reported 1064 target count.

clean_locus_principle: Report broad recovery across the reproducible public 1061 named loci, use the frozen Moreyra-compatible conservative 241 no-warning/high-occupancy set as the primary historical high-stringency layer, and freeze any additional AUTO_STRICT_CLEAN rule before opening focal C. sieboldii transferability results. None is the unpublished final 350-locus matrix.

decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_GREEN: Target-file sensitivity is small or bounded, clean-locus placement is broadly reference-invariant, and Japanese comparison-panel relationships are stable; proceed to 6-10-individual focal WGS R1B pilot.
decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_AMBER: Public loci remain useful for topology/orthology but target-file dependence, reference-specific dropout or distance distortion remains; plan focal C. sieboldii reference in parallel with a small WGS bias audit.
decision_classes.PUBLIC_TRANSFER_RED: C. sieboldii or the Japanese radiation is strongly and inconsistently represented across target/reference choices; focal C. sieboldii long-read chromosome assembly becomes a prerequisite.
decision_classes.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: Target reconstruction or public-data comparability is inadequate; stop public-data expansion and proceed to own-data R1B design.

stop_rule: One bounded target-capture transferability preflight only; do not turn PRJNA957074 into a new aza3 phylogenomics project.

published_moreyra_orthology_rule.intermediate_action: HybPiper paralog retriever + aligned gene-tree inspection
published_moreyra_orthology_rule.boundary: The published 350-locus set depends on manual gene-tree decisions and final alignment filtering and remains unrecovered. The public author repository also reports 1064 mapped target loci while only 1061 named loci are reproducibly identified; R1B-0 must preserve that discrepancy rather than force 350 or 1064 identities.

historical_target_universe.boundary: Do not equate the public 1061-locus HybPiper reference with the exact target/reference used in Moreyra et al. 2023/2025. The authors' public summary files consistently report 1064 mapped target loci, while the reproducible named-locus universe is 1061.

fixed_compatibility_layer.derivation: No paralog warning in the recovered author matrix plus raw sequence occupancy >=0.80 across the public author dataset.

genome_reference_metadata.correction: Any prior 19-chromosome description is superseded by NCBI accession-level assembly reports.
genome_reference_metadata.byte_integrity_rule: R1B-0 localization is fail-closed unless every genome file matches the frozen byte contract; for NCBI .gz references verify both compressed and decompressed MD5.

full_public_transfer_green_reason: Dense multi-individual genome-wide and local-window reference invariance remains untested; the public preflight only establishes sufficient reference viability to justify the own-WGS pilot.
focal_reference_reopen_condition: Own-WGS returns AMBER/RED because genome-wide or local-window inference is materially reference-dependent or phenotype/cytotype-linked technical bias appears.
